profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at Capital One
profile.summary:
I am a seasoned software engineer with extensive experience in the financial services industry. I have a proven track record of success in delivering high-quality software solutions. My technical expertise includes Amazon Web Services (AWS), Javascript, Java, Python, and React. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from George Mason University. In my spare time, I enjoy painting, drawing, and crafting. I share some of my artwork on my YouTube channel.
https://youtube.com/@middlingbat

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
• Researched about patterns and constraints on text, code, and layouts.
• Researched for patterns specific to HTML code.
• Created an HTML Editor using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and jQuery with the help of Ace editor.
• Reported to mentor Dr. Thomas LaToza.
• Created a Poster to present the research.
• Developed scientific writing and communication skills.

Team Developer
• Agile software development team consisting of 10 students with different roles. 
• Used Scrum and Kanban frameworks.

• Open source client running as android application.

projects.title: Web Page “BGgram”
projects.description:
Web Page “BGgram” | Software Engineering two members group project 
•	Created a web page called “BGgram” for users to upload and edit photos. 
•	Users can post photos as private or public and use them as background for any device.
•	User’s information is maintain using Firebase database.
